proposal.description: When deciding whether the record is empty, the episode detector ignores the UVLO bit, as if a recorded UVLO were the routine power-down the capture gate is there to ignore and did not open an episode
proposal.reason: If a UVLO is recorded while the converter is running, and later (with no host read in between) another cause is captured during S_SS or S_RUN, fault_time is re-latched to the later time. The header says fault_time should keep the time the UVLO episode began.

proposal.description: OVP inference is suppressed while OTP is live, as if the over-temperature comparator were a third trip source of the shared protection latch
proposal.reason: If the latch reads back set without latch_assert during S_SS or S_RUN while otp_state is high, the OVP bit (bit 4) of fault_reg is not set. If the record was empty and OTP was the only other live cause, fault_time is still latched, but bit 4 is missing.

proposal.description: OTP is not recorded once OVERCURRENT is in the record, on the belief that an over-temperature after an overcurrent is only the heating the overcurrent caused
proposal.reason: Sequence: a window trip records OVERCURRENT, the hiccup retry restarts the converter, and then otp_state rises during S_SS or S_RUN, all with no host read in between. The OTP bit (bit 2) of fault_reg stays clear, when the header requires every cause seen while running to be accumulated.
